name: lazy-travel-planner
description: Domestic China free-travel planner that turns real-time reviews and first-hand data into a visual itinerary book (Leaflet map, route, budget chart, risk panel).

author.name: Qclaw 官方高质量 Agent · 懒人出游规划师

displayDescription.en: Plans domestic China 3-7 day free trips for 2-4 people; turns real-time reviews and first-hand data into a visual itinerary book with map, budget and pitfall warnings.
displayDescription.zh: 专注国内3-7天2-4人自由行，整合实时口碑与一手数据，一站式产出含地图、预算与防坑的可落地行程书。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我规划一次成都4天3晚2人自由行，想轻松点、吃好点。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Plan me a relaxed 4-day, 3-night, 2-person free trip to Chengdu with good food.

quickPrompts.en: Plan me a relaxed 4-day, 3-night, 2-person free trip to Chengdu with good food.
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我规划一次成都4天3晚2人自由行，想轻松点、吃好点。
推荐几个适合老人和小孩的轻松路线。

quickPrompts.en: I want to go to Chongqing on Labour Day — help me arrange crowds and budget.
quickPrompts.zh: 我想五一去重庆，帮我看看人流和预算怎么安排。
